details:
Harbor maintainers would like to clarify that CVE-2026-4404 has not been reviewed or acknowledged by the Harbor maintainer team as a valid Harbor vulnerability.
At this time, the CVE entry is still in “Awaiting Analysis” status, and we believe its description and severity do not accurately reflect the actual Harbor security model and deployment requirements.

The harbor.yml.tmpl is a sample file. Users are required to provide their own harbor.yml file during installation, and this file is generated by the user themselves, making the issue unrelated to the Harbor software's installation defaults.

It is a fundamental and widely accepted security practice that users must install Harbor with their own custom password. This requirement is explicit and expected in production deployments, and it should not be classified as a product vulnerability.

We are actively contacting the relevant organizations and requesting rejection of this CVE.
